title: Enter Mod
description: Makes Enter accept Minecraft command suggestions in chat before sending the command.
body:
# Enter Mod

  Enter Mod is a small client-side Fabric mod that changes how Enter works with Minecraft command suggestions.

  When command suggestions are open in chat, pressing Enter accepts the selected suggestion instead of instantly sending
  the command. If you want to send the command immediately, press Ctrl+Enter.

  ## Features

  - Enter accepts the selected command suggestion
  - Ctrl+Enter sends the command immediately
  - Works only on the client side
  - No server installation required

  ## Requirements

  - Minecraft 1.21.11
  - Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer
  - Java 21 or newer

  ## Usage

  Install the mod into your `mods` folder and launch Minecraft with Fabric.

  Open chat, start typing a command, and use Enter to accept suggestions.
